title: Wider Goodreads pages
question: How do I make Goodreads use the full width of the screen?
answer: Goodreads has no layout or width setting. Book pages sit in a centred frame capped at 1260 pixels, and the description wraps in a narrower column inside it. The usermods script on this page removes the cap so the page fills the window with a small margin, and lets the description and other text paragraphs run across the whole right-hand column. Without a script, zooming the browser out is the only way to fit more on screen.
prompt: Make Goodreads book pages use the full width of the window.
details:
The script is two CSS rules injected before the page draws. It widens `.PageFrame`, the container Goodreads' newer pages use, and lets the paragraph blocks span the full right-hand grid. The cover and buttons column grows with the page.

Older Goodreads pages, such as lists, series and shelves, use a different fixed-width layout and are not changed. The check loads a book page.

alternatives.title: Browser zoom
alternatives.body: Zooming out (Ctrl or Cmd and minus) shrinks everything, so more fits in the same frame. It does not change the frame's width.

check.baseline: (() => { const f = document.querySelector('.PageFrame').getBoundingClientRect().width; const d = document.querySelector('[data-testid="description"] .DetailsLayoutRightParagraph__widthConstrained').getBoundingClientRect().width; return f < innerWidth - 120 && d < 0.8 * document.querySelector('.BookPage__mainContent').getBoundingClientRect().width; })()
check.expect: (() => { const frame = document.querySelector('.PageFrame'); const d = document.querySelector('[data-testid="description"] .DetailsLayoutRightParagraph__widthConstrained'); const main = document.querySelector('.BookPage__mainContent'); return frame.getBoundingClientRect().width >= innerWidth - 80 && d.checkVisibility() && d.getBoundingClientRect().width >= 0.95 * main.getBoundingClientRect().width; })()
check.intact: (() => { const h = document.querySelector('h1[data-testid="bookTitle"]'); const cover = document.querySelector('.BookPage__leftColumn .BookCover img'); return !!h && h.checkVisibility() && !!cover && cover.checkVisibility() && document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth && [...document.querySelectorAll('.BookPageMetadataSection a')].filter((a) => a.checkVisibility()).length >= 5; })()
